question: Who among the following has won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2024 in Dogri for his book 'Ik Hor Ashwthama'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaman Arora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chaman Arora** is a renowned author in the **Dogri language**, which is widely spoken in the Jammu region of India.
 
• He has been awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award 2024** for his exceptional literary contribution through his book titled **'Ik Hor Ashwthama.'**
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi Award** is one of the most prestigious literary honors in India, presented annually to authors for their outstanding works in **24 recognized Indian languages**.
 
• The book **'Ik Hor Ashwthama'** is a remarkable work of fiction that explores deep philosophical themes and the human condition, earning critical acclaim from literary experts and readers.
 
• The award not only acknowledges the literary excellence of **Chaman Arora** but also highlights the richness and cultural significance of the **Dogri language.**
 
• Through his writings, **Chaman Arora** has significantly contributed to the growth and preservation of **Dogri literature**, making him a deserving recipient of this honor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Madhav Kaushik**__

 __
 
• **Madhav Kaushik** is a celebrated Hindi and Punjabi poet but has no contribution to Dogri literature or the book '**Ik Hor Ashwthama**'.
 
• He is known for his contributions to modern Hindi poetry and literature.
 
 
 
• **Vilas Dangre**__
 __
 
• **Vilas Dangre** is a Marathi writer known for his works in Marathi literature.
 
• He has no association with the **Dogri language** or the book '**Ik Hor Ashwthama**'.
 
 
 
• **Velu Aasaan**__
 
 
• **Velu Aasaan** is a Tamil writer known for his contributions to **Tamil literature**.
 
• He has not worked in the **Dogri language** or authored the book '**Ik Hor Ashwthama**'.
